_help: Desk entries: things a person has checked or tested. They always show on the site and override an automatic item with the same URL or headline. status: Official (Rockstar said it, link to Rockstar), Tested (we reproduced it ourselves; needs the tested block, and for cheats the cheat block, for glitches the glitch block), Reported (a named outlet said it; link to that outlet), Patched (a glitch that no longer reproduces), Unverified (a lead, not checked). The updater refuses to show Tested without the proof fields. Run: node tools/update-feed.mjs --check to validate this file.

cheat.input: Phone open, hold L1+R1 / LB+RB, then Up, Right, Down, Left, Up, Left, Down, Right

entries.title: Update 1.002.002: seven fixes, from crashes and autosave to story phone calls
entries.evidence: Rockstar's notes as quoted: crashes; weather not changing; autosave; phone calls that progress the story or unlock missions; Wanted Level that could not be lost; gym deadlift bar; partners not handing over bags for fences. About 1.6 GB on Xbox Series X|S.
entries.note: The desk could not open support.rockstargames.com from the scanner (it timed out), so this is Reported until the Rockstar page itself is linked.

entries.title: Cheats only work after you finish the story, and each one must be unlocked by a challenge
entries.evidence: GamesRadar+ lists 61 cheats. Input: phone open (D-pad Up), hold L1+R1 / LB+RB, then the D-pad code. It reports that a cheat disables trophies/achievements and saving for that session. Many codes are still listed as TBC.
entries.note: Not tested by the desk yet. Record a clip before marking any code Tested.

entries.title: Players say the first-person glitch still works after update 1.002.002
entries.evidence: Pure Xbox passes on player impressions and says to take them with a pinch of salt.
entries.note: Lead only. Re-test on 1.002.002 before filming.

_help_rejected: rejected: automatic findings a person checked and found wrong, or a repeat of a story already on the board. Each rule names a title (the headline as the scanner saw it), a url, or a whole publisher, plus why (one sentence). Matching items never show again. Desk entries above are never rejected.

rejected.why: Its 26 Nov launch-glitch piece said Rockstar confirmed only crash fixes, but Rockstar's 23 Nov notes list seven fixes (GamesRadar+, Pure Xbox); its other GTA posts carry claims with no source.
